Explain one reason a portable measuring device may use an OS configured only for its required hardware and tasks

markscheme.marking_summary: The OS can omit unused services, reducing memory and processing overhead. This leaves limited resources available for measurement/control tasks, helping the device meet its performance needs.
source_issues: Original MS suggests prohibiting updates improves security; this is not copied.
